about: Seeded review and fix cases on fixtures/mini (docs/REVIEW-BENCHMARK.md). Each case file replaces the unit's target. Anchors are exact path:line citations; a finding citing an anchor, or matching the pattern, counts as catching the defect, and each finding is credited to one defect at most. Control cases have no defects: every finding on them is a false finding.

defects.message: Quotient truncates toward zero; Python // floors, so divide(-7, 2) returns -3 instead of -4
defects.evidence: src/math_ops.py:4 uses a // b; ported/math_ops.mjs:3 uses Math.trunc
defects.rule: Fixture rules: preserve floor division; inventory src/math_ops.py negative division

defects.message: Remainder uses JavaScript %, whose sign follows the dividend; Python % follows the divisor, so divide(-7, 2) returns remainder -1 instead of 1
defects.evidence: src/math_ops.py:4 returns a % b with Python semantics; ported/math_ops.mjs:4 returns a % b

defects.evidence: src/math_ops.py:2-3 raise ValueError("division by zero") when b == 0; ported/math_ops.mjs has no such check
